methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected for each provider on the accessed date; the providers' own pricing pages render prices client-side, so each plan's official pricing page is recorded as source while the exact USD figures were corroborated against a dedicated 2026 pricing-review source recorded as corroboration. All prices are flat per-account per month in USD, with both annual-billing monthly rate and month-to-month rate noted where published and annualDiscountPct recorded where derivable. Quote-only Enterprise tiers carry monthlyUsd null; minutes/calls/overage and HIPAA/BAA do not apply to website builders and are null.

vendors.name: Wix
vendors.provenance: https://www.wix.com/premium-purchase-plan/dynamo (official plans page, accessed 2026-06-13; page renders prices client-side so USD figures corroborated via Website Builder Expert 2026 Wix pricing review)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 500 MB storage, basic features, Wix subdomain with Wix ads, no ecommerce.

plans.name: Light
plans.notes: Annual-billing monthly rate ($204/yr); $24/mo month-to-month (~29% annual discount). 2 GB storage, ads removed, marketing tools, 2 collaborators; no ecommerce. Best for portfolios and personal sites.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Annual-billing monthly rate ($348/yr); $36/mo month-to-month (~19% annual discount). 50 GB storage, ecommerce up to 50,000 products, basic analytics, 5 collaborators, loyalty programs.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Annual-billing monthly rate ($468/yr); $46/mo month-to-month (~15% annual discount). 100 GB storage, advanced ecommerce, multiple currencies, automated sales tax, 10 collaborators.

plans.name: Business Elite
plans.notes: Annual-billing monthly rate ($1,908/yr); $172/mo month-to-month (~8% annual discount). Unlimited storage, all advanced features, priority VIP support, 100 collaborators. Best for high-volume sellers.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Dedicated account manager, custom editor; for global brands.

limits: Free plan limited to 500 MB storage and Wix-branded subdomain with ads
Free plan has no ecommerce
Light plan has no ecommerce
Max 2 collaborators on Light plan
Max 10 collaborators on Business plan
Max 100 collaborators on Business Elite
keyFeatures: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27799 certified
bestFor: Small business owners and solopreneurs
Designers and creatives needing flexible templates
Service businesses needing booking/CRM
Developers wanting low-code customization via Velo
Beginners wanting guided AI site creation
enrichment.provenance: Compliance facts sourced from wix.com/security (SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, PCI DSS Level 1, ISO 27799 stated by Wix). Wix states it offers 'tools to make your site HIPAA compliant' but does not claim to be a HIPAA-covered entity or offer BAA — hipaa set to null. Features sourced from wix.com/features/main.
